confirmations.check: Six write tools match design contracts (names/params/verbs/endpoints/success strings)
confirmations.evidence: jira_create_story -> POST /stories body=all params, '✅ Story created successfully: **{id}** - {title}'. jira_update_story -> pre-GET /stories/{id}, guards (not-found / unresolved-assignee / no-changes), PUT /stories/{id} with only provided fields, '✅ Story updated successfully: **{id}** - {title}'. github_create_branch -> POST /repos/{repo_id}/branches body={name,from_branch}, '✅ Branch created successfully: **{name}**'. github_commit_files -> POST /repos/{repo_id}/commits body={branch,message,files:_normalize_files_arg}, '✅ Committed {n} files to **{branch}**' (+ optional url). github_open_pull_request -> POST /repos/{repo_id}/pulls body={head,base,title:title or head,body}, '✅ Pull request opened: **#{number}** {title}' (+ optional url). servicenow_create_incident -> POST /incidents body=all params, '✅ Incident opened successfully: **{id}** - {title} ({severity})'. Verified by reading the three write modules and the test assertions.

github_create_branch lowercases data['error'] and returns the '✅ Branch **{branch_name}** already exists — reusing it.' success string when the text contains 'status 409' or 'status 422' or 'already exists'; test_github_create_branch_already_exists_is_success asserts the 409 case yields the success string.

confirmations.check: Propose path performs NO HTTP write; approve path DOES
confirmations.evidence: The POST/PUT lives only in the tool body; WriteApprovalHook._before_tool_call calls event.interrupt('write_approval', ...) in BeforeToolCallEvent, which raises InterruptException on the first pass before the body runs. test_hook_propose_path_raises_interrupt_for_every_write_tool monkeypatches make_request to raise on any call and asserts InterruptException with zero write calls across all six tools. On resume interrupt() returns 'APPROVE', the hook does not cancel, and the body issues the real write.

On any non-'APPROVE' response the hook sets event.cancel_tool = 'Write rejected by user.'; test_hook_reject_path_sets_cancel_tool confirms and asserts no body runs. test_hook_approve_path_lets_body_proceed confirms cancel_tool stays False on approve.

chat._emit_system_signal switches on proposal['action'] with the three verbatim templates (create_branch / commit_files / open_pull_request) substituting params keys repo_id/branch_name/branch/head/base, plus the generic fallback "[SYSTEM] The user approved and the '{action}' action was executed." for the other writes; appended as an assistant-role message to agent.messages on APPROVE only. Driver tests confirm the branch breadcrumb on approve, nothing on reject, and the generic fallback for create_incident.
